**One-line summary**: Anthropic researchers reportedly warned that highly capable AI, if it slips out of human control, could pose an existential threat.

### Key points
- Per The Hill, Anthropic researchers publicly cautioned about the potential dangers of "out-of-control" AI.
- The warning is said to stress that safety measures and control mechanisms must keep pace with rapidly growing AI capabilities.
- Anthropic has long positioned AI safety and alignment research as central to its mission.

### Why it matters
A warning coming from researchers at a company that builds frontier AI itself adds weight to ongoing safety and regulatory debates. The specific scenarios and evidence behind the claim should be verified in the original report.
